anomalies.description: A red sedan on the right side of the road collides with the rear-left quarter of the black sedan ahead, causing the red car to swerve sharply left and rotate counter-clockwise while still in contact or immediate aftermath; visible vehicle deformation and loss of control occur.; A red sedan on the right side of the road collides with or is struck by the black sedan in front, causing the red car to veer sharply right off the paved road onto the shoulder and dirt area.

A dark-colored sedan on the left side of the road loses control while navigating a curve, veers sharply left across the centerline, and collides with an oncoming white vehicle (visible in f12–f15). The impact occurs around f14–f15, with both vehicles visibly displaced and coming to rest at an angle post-collision.

A vehicle on the right side of the road loses control, slides sideways into the snowbank, and kicks up a large plume of snow and debris; its red taillights remain visible as it comes to rest off the roadway.
